title: The Ratio in the Jam Cellar
story: Grumworth the Preserve Gnome has sealed the orphanage cellar and won't release a single jar until someone brews his winter jam correctly. His recipe demands berries and honey in the ratio 5 to 2, and there are 350 berries in the copper pot. Mr 6 ties on an apron over his cape.
question: For 350 berries at a 5-to-2 ratio of berries to honey, how many spoons of honey are needed?
hint: Find out how many berries make one 'part' by dividing 350 by 5, then take 2 of those parts.
victory: Mr 6 stirred in exactly 140 spoons and the jam glowed ruby-perfect; Grumworth tasted it, wept happily into his beard, and gave the orphanage every jar in the cellar.
imagePrompt: A cozy stone cellar crowded with glowing jam jars, a tiny bearded gnome supervising as an apron-wearing numeral-six knight stirs a huge copper pot of berries and honey.
